notes: Captured from the help sandbox (~/owbn/_localwp-oat/help) after seed-cc-shots.php: made-up people, chronicles and offices. C&C Manager's screens are English-only, so the Portuguese pages reuse these images with Portuguese alt text.

alt.en: Chronicles: Add New Chronicle, the All, Published and Decommissioned filters, and the chronicles with their Compliance badges, OK or a number missing.
alt.pt_BR: Chronicles: Add New Chronicle, os filtros All, Published e Decommissioned, e as crônicas com os selos de Compliance, OK ou quantos faltam.

alt.en: Editing Tides of Ash as its HST: the name, the LOCAL bar, the greyed-out Chronicle Slug, Probationary and Satellite, the five tabs and the Description editor.
alt.pt_BR: Editando Tides of Ash como HST: o nome, a barra LOCAL, Chronicle Slug, Probationary e Satellite em cinza, as cinco abas e o editor de Description.

alt.en: HST Info: User, Display Name, Actual Email and Display Email, under the hint to pick the account and fill in the name and both emails.
alt.pt_BR: HST Info: User, Display Name, Actual Email e Display Email, sob a dica de escolher a conta e preencher o nome e os dois emails.

alt.en: AST Info: an AST with User and Remove, Display Name, Role, Actual Email and Display Email, and Add.
alt.pt_BR: AST Info: um AST com User e Remove, Display Name, Role, Actual Email e Display Email, e Add.

alt.en: Coordinators: Add New Coordinator, the All and Published filters, and the offices.
alt.pt_BR: Coordinators: Add New Coordinator, os filtros All e Published, e os escritórios.

alt.en: Editing the Sabbat Coordinator office as its coordinator: four tabs, Description, Staff, History and Links, with the office's description, Hosting Chronicle and term dates.
alt.pt_BR: Editando o escritório Sabbat Coordinator como coordenador: quatro abas, Description, Staff, History e Links, com a descrição do escritório, Hosting Chronicle e as datas do mandato.

alt.en: The Staff tab: its instructions, then a sub-coordinator with User and Remove, Display Name, Role, Actual Email and Display Email, and Add.
alt.pt_BR: A aba Staff: as instruções e um subcoordenador com User e Remove, Display Name, Role, Actual Email e Display Email, e Add.

alt.en: Pending Staff Changes: two change sets, one on Glass Orchard flagged Self-promotion detected, each with its Field and Pending Value and the Approve and Reject buttons.
alt.pt_BR: Pending Staff Changes: dois conjuntos de mudanças, um em Glass Orchard marcado Self-promotion detected, cada um com Field e Pending Value e os botões Approve e Reject.

alt.en: The HST & AST Report: the count line, the filter box, Only chronicles with a missing name or email, Export CSV, and a row per chronicle with its HST and staff emails, a missing one marked No email.
alt.pt_BR: O HST & AST Report: a linha de contagem, a caixa de filtro, Only chronicles with a missing name or email, Export CSV e uma linha por crônica com os emails do HST e da staff, um que falta marcado No email.

alt.en: C&C Plugin Settings: Enable Chronicle management, Enable Coordinator management, and the Available Genres and Available Regions lists.
alt.pt_BR: C&C Plugin Settings: Enable Chronicle management, Enable Coordinator management e as listas Available Genres e Available Regions.
